facts.label: Breach notification response time
facts.quote: Processor shall notify the Brightmart DPO of a Personal Data Breach within 24 hours of becoming aware

facts.label: Audit notice period
facts.quote: Brightmart may audit annually with 30 days' notice

facts.label: Remote work allowed
facts.quote: Personnel processing Personal Data must not work remotely

facts.label: Sub‑processor consent required
facts.quote: Sub‑processors require Brightmart's prior written consent

facts.label: International transfer destination country
facts.quote: To India under the UK IDTA
